reviews.title: Quarterly Inspection
reviews.text: On Sept 15, I received notice to perform an inspection. I made the inspection and submitted it. On September 16 , I received notice to perform an inspection. I made the inspection and submitted it. Eight minutes later I received another notice to perform an inspection. I have Submitted three inspections in 24 hours. Please accept one of those as the quarterly inspection. And I will happily make another inspection in three months.

reviews.title: Basic app but has  potential
reviews.text: Not to make this too long but the app suffers from a clunky UI that requires too much clicking and repeated or redundant steps due to the app not recognizing the input. From a UX standpoint, you lose the ability to view your saved view lists causing you to need to manually filter views. You also can’t view active assignments without selecting a vehicle first.

reviews.title: Fleet mechanic
reviews.text: Fleetio Go app is Horrible, the app freezes all the time. It doesn’t clock out even though you clocked out on the work order. The next day when you come in, it shows you are still working on the truck from the previous day. Some time it kicks you out of the app. At least 2 times a week we have to uninstall the app and reload it just to get it to work. It throws error codes all the time when you try to add notes to a work order. Worst app I ever used. The Fleetio app on the computer works great but the Fleetio Go app is trash.
